string.text: Chance that a captured hero loses any gear at all. Rolled once per capture. Default: 80%
After the main roll passes, each equipped item is rolled separately. 100% strips everything. Default: 80%
Items worth less than this are never taken. 0 disables the filter. Default: 200
Heroes freed while wearing rags receive a fresh vanilla-generated equipment set. Default: true
Battle equipment set can be taken. Default: true
Civilian equipment set can be taken. Default: false
Stealth equipment set can be taken. Default: false
Heroes outside the player clan can lose gear. Default: true
The player character can lose gear. Default: true
Family and companions in the player clan can lose gear. Does not include caravan masters. Default: true
Companions leading player caravans can lose gear. Default: true
When the player captures a hero, their gear is taken and added to the player inventory. Default: true
Bandit captors ignore the chance roll and always take gear. Default: true
Captor party leader with positive Honor trait never takes gear. Default: true
Captor party leader with positive Mercy trait never takes gear. Default: true
Captor party leader with negative Honor trait ignores the chance roll and always takes gear. Default: true
Captor party leader with relation at or above the threshold never takes gear. Default: true
Relation value at which a captor is considered friendly. Default: 10
When a hero is executed, every item from the battle, civilian and stealth sets goes to the executioner's party inventory. Applies to player and AI executions. Default: true
Logging for debugging (English only). Default: false
